caption: Pipeline of the project: run_all.sh orchestrates the C++17 simulator (event-driven hard-sphere MD with collision Verlet and Ewald/DSF Coulomb), which writes the trajectory as extended XYZ plus an npz cache, JSON metadata and a per-frame diagnostics CSV; sim/analyze.py scans every frame for overlaps and computes energy drift and pairing statistics, while render_ovito.py (Tachyon ray tracer, numpy fallback) produces 721 PNG frames per movie that ffmpeg encodes to H.264 mp4.
